context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 57 verified contract language support and Section 6 device security. Contract endpoints at /api/contracts/{client_id}/preview and /api/contracts/{client_id}/download accept 'language' query param ('et' or 'en', defaults to 'et'). PDF contains 9 sections, Section 6 covers app installation and device locking. Estonian uses 'LAENULEPING' title, English uses 'LOAN AGREEMENT'. PyPDF2 used for PDF text extraction to verify content.
